text:
Maria Chen: incident-bot paged us for a latency SLO breach in production, p99 is spiking to ~2.3s across streaming endpoints. anyone oncall?
incident-bot: ALERT: service=continuous-batcher region=us-west-2 severity=page breach=SLO(p99>1s) ts=4278901234
Samir Patel: I'm on it, joining. seeing similar in dashboards (p95 ~600ms, p99 ~2300ms). correlated with cont-batch tail queue depth rising.
Ryan O'Neill: I'm looking at scheduler metrics — queue skew on GPU-pool-3, mixed sequence lengths have a lot of oddpack events.
Nina Gomez: Support reported two customers saw stalled streaming sessions and retries. support ticket #SUP-8921. possible impact on streaming hedges.
Leo Park: digging into traces now. I see streaming stalls where the batch waits for a single long sequence before dispatch. packing shows 60% small / 10% long sequences causing padding amplification.
Priya Shah: any recent changes to packer or max_batch_size?
Samir Patel: No deploys in the last hour. config looks unchanged. autoscaler added a node earlier but tail stayed.
Maria Chen: Ops question — can we temporarily lower max_batch_wait to reduce tail wait? tradeoff labs with throughput.
Ryan O'Neill: propose: set max_batch_wait=6ms -> 3ms for streaming-specific path for 15m, reduce max_batch_size from 64->32 for cont-batch streaming. This should reduce waiting for long seqs.
Nina Gomez: +1 for quick mitigation. notify support and customers: we may increase token cost but lower stall risk.
incident-bot: ACTION: applied runtime flag streaming.max_batch_wait=3ms to pool GPU-pool-3 (actor=Samir)
Samir Patel: I applied that change to the canary subset (~10% of traffic). initial effect: p99 for canary down to 1.1s, overall p99 still ~2.2s.
Leo Park: can we scale routing to shift more streaming traffic to dedicated pool (gpu-dedicated-1) temporarily? That pool has lower queue depth.
Maria Chen: yes, run a slow shift 20% -> dedicated. ensure routing policy has fallback.
Samir Patel: Kicking route change (gradual). monitor for error bursts.
Ryan O'Neill: also enabling preemptive-shedding for oversized batches: drop padding over 80% if queue depth > threshold. config snippet I recommend:
```
service.contbatch.preemptive_shed = true
service.contbatch.pad_threshold = 0.8
service.contbatch.shed_action = "hedge_to_stream"
```
Priya Shah: logs show KV-cache churn around same time — maybe long seqs are pulling large KV pages and eviction is blocking. Could be contributing to p99.
Leo Park: good catch. I'll increase kv-cache soft limit and stagger eviction to avoid stop-the-world.
Nina Gomez: support update posted: "We're aware of streaming stalls for some customers; engineers are actively mitigating. ETA 30m." :hourglass_flowing_sand: #SUP-8921
Samir Patel: After route shift + preemptive-shed + canary wait reduction, canary p99 = 0.95s, main pool p99 = 1.05s now. overall p99 trending down.
Maria Chen: great. next steps: keep mitigations for 30m, collect traces for the worst 1% requests, and prepare a post-incident blameless writeup. Assigning followups: root-cause triage for packer heuristics (owner=Ryan), KV eviction tuning (owner=Leo), long-tail workload eval (owner=Priya).
Ryan O'Neill: noted. I'll instrument per-seqlen packing latency and produce a histogram of wait times by seq bucket.
Leo Park: I'll open a change to make KV-cache eviction incremental and add metrics for eviction pause duration.
Priya Shah: I'll coordinate with Product to surface if specific customers are sending extremely long sequences that amplify padding; may need guidance on batching-friendly payloads.
Nina Gomez: Support will send a targeted customer notification to affected accounts and update incident status.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated->partial-restored, page escalated -> monitoring. p99 reduced to ~1.0s.
Samir Patel: leaving route shift active and keep max_batch_wait=3ms for 45m. Will revert to defaults after stability.
Maria Chen: handoff summary for next oncall:
- what happened: cont-batch scheduling + mixed seqlen led to tail waits, padding amplification and KV eviction added pauses -> p99 spike >1s
- mitigations performed: reduced streaming.max_batch_wait, canaryed change, enabled preemptive_shedding, gradual routing to dedicated pool, kv-cache soft-limit bump
- customer impact: transient streaming stalls, 2 customers filed support tickets (SUP-8921, SUP-8922) — no data loss, increased latency and retries observed
- followups: packer heuristics (Ryan), kv/eviction tuning (Leo), workload analysis + product outreach (Priya), postmortem doc (Maria)
Please tag if you pick up any followup. I'll start the postmortem draft.
Ryan O'Neill: ping me if you need data slices, I'll attach histograms.
Priya Shah: I'll loop in product and solutions for customer guidance.
Samir Patel: monitoring shows stable for 10m, closing active page but keeping thread open for handoff. :white_check_mark:
